keyboard_mode_main.description: GNOME Calculator is open in Keyboard mode showing the unit conversion interface. The top bar includes the mode selector and main menu, while the content area has unit dropdowns, a swap button, a conversion result label, and a large input/history region.

keyboard_mode_selector_open.description: The Keyboard mode screen is visible with the mode selector dropdown expanded, showing all available calculator modes. The main conversion interface remains visible behind the popup.

advanced_mode_main.description: GNOME Calculator is now in Advanced mode, showing a scientific keypad along with the same unit conversion strip and expression/history area. The mode selector and main menu are available from the header bar.

advanced_mode_selector_open.description: Advanced mode is visible with the mode selector popup expanded. The popup lists all calculator modes while the scientific keypad and unit conversion strip remain accessible in the background.

financial_mode_main.description: GNOME Calculator is in Financial mode with a financial keypad, unit conversion strip, empty history/display area, and a bottom financial function selector dropdown. The header bar includes the mode selector and main menu.

financial_mode_selector_open.description: Financial mode is visible with its keypad and bottom function selector, and the mode selector popup is expanded showing all calculator modes. This popup allows switching to undiscovered top-level modes.

programming_mode_main.description: GNOME Calculator is in Programming mode with a programmer keypad, number-base selector, bit display panel, and word-size dropdown. The header bar still provides the mode selector and main menu.

programming_mode_selector_open.description: Programming mode is visible with the mode selector popup expanded. The popup lists all calculator modes while the programmer keypad, base selector, bit display, and word-size selector remain visible behind it.

basic_mode_main.description: GNOME Calculator is in Basic mode with a standard keypad, a large empty display/history area, an expression input field, and header controls for mode selection and the main menu.

basic_main_menu_open.description: Basic mode is visible with the standard keypad and empty display, and the main application menu is expanded. The menu exposes number format choices plus entries for Preferences, Keyboard Shortcuts, Help, and About Calculator.

keyboard_shortcuts_page_1.description: A keyboard shortcuts overlay/dialog is open on page 1, listing general shortcuts, mode-switching shortcuts, keyboard entry shortcuts, and programming mode shortcuts. The dialog has search, close, and pagination controls.

keyboard_shortcuts_page_2.description: The keyboard shortcuts overlay is open on page 2, showing the 'Others' shortcut category with copy, paste, undo/redo, result navigation, and alternate keyboard mode shortcut. Pagination controls and close button are available.

about_dialog_open.description: The About Calculator dialog is open on top of Basic mode. It shows app information, website and license links, plus Credits and Close buttons while the calculator keypad remains visible but backgrounded.
